snapshot_deployment_actions.command_exact:
cd /media/okami/Mio/Siegfried
/usr/bin/python3 -B - <<'PY'
import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path
from tools.install_boot_briefing import _validate_home, package_sources, prepare_package
root = Path.cwd()
home = _validate_home(Path.home())
evidence = json.loads((root / 'docs/gates/GATE_F5_5_EVIDENCE.json').read_text())
plans = [(True, evidence['source_hashes']), (False, evidence['briefing_source_hashes'])]
for daemon, reviewed in plans:
    sources = package_sources(root, daemon=daemon)
    assert {name: hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest() for name, data in sources.items()} == reviewed
for daemon, reviewed in plans:
    package = prepare_package(home, root, False, daemon=daemon)
    assert {name: hashlib.sha256((package / name).read_bytes()).hexdigest() for name in reviewed} == reviewed
    print('Snapshot privado verificado:', package)
PY
